name: José González | Misty Fest
description: José González performs at Coliseu Porto Ageas as part of the 17th edition of Misty Fest. He will present new material from his album "Against The Dying Of The Light", alongside songs from his discography.
longDescription:
José González is confirmed for the 17th edition of Misty Fest, performing at Coliseu Porto Ageas on November 2, 2026, at 21:00. He will present his new album, "Against The Dying Of The Light", which explores themes of humanity, technology, and the contemporary world.

The concert setlist will include new songs and notable tracks from his career, such as "Heartbeats" from his debut album "Veneer" (2003). González is known for transforming voice and guitar into a vast and immersive concert experience, moving between intimate and rhythmically intense moments.

Tickets are available with prices ranging from €30 for Balcão Popular and Galeria, to €35 for Tribuna. Box seats for six people are priced at €210 for Camarote de 1ª and €180 for Frisas. For information on tickets for people with reduced mobility, contact the Coliseu Porto Ageas box office.

longDescriptionPt:

O alinhamento do concerto incluirá novas canções e temas marcantes da sua carreira, como "Heartbeats" do seu álbum de estreia "Veneer" (2003). González é conhecido por transformar voz e guitarra numa experiência de concerto vasta e imersiva, alternando entre momentos íntimos e ritmicamente intensos.

Os bilhetes estão disponíveis com preços que variam entre os 30€ para Balcão Popular e Galeria, e os 35€ para Tribuna. Os camarotes para seis pessoas custam 210€ para Camarote de 1.ª e 180€ para Frisas. Para informações sobre bilhetes para pessoas com mobilidade reduzida, contacte a bilheteira do Coliseu Porto Ageas.
